stage1.impression: A clean, plausible room with a witty idea (the carton's silhouette thrown onto a warm sun patch) and good copy space, but the light does not hold together: the crisp wall shadow floats far from a speaker that casts no matching shadow or sun across the floor, so the speaker looks composited. Its white front is one flat value that reads as card, the speaker is smallish in frame and the floor and walls read as stock CG; a competent draft, not yet a homepage hero.

blocking_9: White front at 200-220 with a visible 10-20-level eave-to-plinth lacquer ramp and nothing on the flat white above 228 (now 248-250 with 1-2 levels of range inside each band).

Accent red on its lit faces within dE 3 of #C62828 at the exposure the white needs (it matches today, gable dE 0.5, only because the frame is about 0.6 EV hot; after the cut it will print near [162,24,25], dE about 8).
Room walls at 185-210 while the white front stays at or under 220 (the walls read bright today only because the product is blown).

The speaker's shadow legible and continuous from the plinth across the floor to the wall silhouette, at least 20 levels under the sunlit floor beside it, with plank-to-plank swings smaller than that; the in-beam floor visibly brighter than the out-of-beam floor (now 134.6 vs 128.8).
Shaded side about one stop under the front (148-165) and the shaded red plinth side keeping its hue (now [128,23,6], blue crushed to 6, reads brick-brown).
Set surfaces with magazine-scale life: oak plank tones and grain that read as a real floor, walls with tonal variation instead of flat fields that range 3-4 levels.

changes.problem: The white front is held in the PBR Neutral shoulder, so it prints as one flat value: no ramp, reflection or modelling can show and it reads as card set between the red parts.

evidence.measured: lum_median 248.4, lum_range 1.2 (band between the drivers); [398,332,512,360] 249.8, range 1.8; low front [494,630,514,656] 239.5. Inverted through PBR Neutral these are scene-linear about 1.5-1.65 and 1.0, all above the 0.76 knee, so a 1.6x light difference down the face prints as 9 levels.

changes.expected: Low front [494,630,514,656] 239.5 -> 202-212; band between the drivers [400,442,512,486] 248.4 -> about 212-220; the whole frame about 0.6 EV darker: unlit back wall [1180,200,1340,340] 203 -> about 164 (c4 restores it), gable [197,41,42] -> about [162,24,25].

changes.problem: The lacquer_ramp reflection adds about +0.6 scene-linear to the top of the front, so once c1 takes the white off the shoulder, strength 30 would push the upper half back above 226 and print a 35-40-level stripe instead of a soft ramp.

evidence.measured: 8-bin profile 248.8, 248.6, 248.5, 247.6, 246.5, 244.2, 241.1, 239.6 (falloff 9.2, all above 226) = scene-linear 1.62 at the eave to 0.99 at the plinth; traced, the panel is mirrored over 146 of 165 points on the front, ramp 0 at z 0.25 rising to 1 at z 0.8.

changes.expected: A soft eave-to-plinth ramp on the white: first bin about 220-226, last bin about 205, falloff 10-20; no flat white above 228.

changes.problem: At the exposure c1 sets, the right side falls to about 133 and reads as grey card next to a 207-220 front; a white box's shaded face should sit about one stop under its lit face.

evidence.measured: lum_median 165.0, lum_range 16 (scene-linear 0.42 against the front's 1.0); scaled by c1's 0.66 it becomes about 133.

changes.expected: Side [525,335,605,630] at 148-162 at the new exposure, 50-60 levels (about one stop) under the front, cool against the warm-lit front; the shaded red plinth side lifts with it.

changes.problem: The front faces both windows and the sun and takes about 1.6x the light of the unlit back wall, so an exposure that models the white drops the walls to about 164 and the bright, airy room goes grey; the walls need light the front does not see.

evidence.measured: lum_median 203.2 (scene-linear 0.63) vs low front 239.5 (scene-linear 1.0): the walls sit 0.7 EV under the white; sun patch [960,360,1120,520] 234.8 vs the unlit wall beside it 199.5.

changes.expected: An upright panel 1 m off the back wall, above the speaker, facing the wall: it sits behind the front's plane, so the front, side, floor and the c1-c3 and c5 regions move under 3 levels; upper back wall +16 to +30 over its post-c1 level, a little more toward the top of frame than at the skirting; the sun patch keeps about 30 levels over the unlit wall at its height.

changes.problem: Plank-to-plank tone swings are larger than the sun's contrast on the floor, so the beam and the speaker's floor shadow vanish into the planks and the crisp wall silhouette reads as detached from the speaker.

evidence.measured: lum_range 35.3 in an evenly sunlit patch; plank medians 141 / 112 / 124 down one column (x 1240-1250); the speaker's floor shadow [700,600,830,620] median 99.4 vs the sunlit floor past its edge [880,615,1090,640] 129.3; in-beam foreground 134.6 vs out-of-beam foreground [1150,720,1350,880] 128.8.

changes.expected: Evenly lit floor lum_range 14-24 with plank medians within about 8 levels of each other, so the shadow band from the plinth to the skirting (about 20 levels under the sunlit floor after c1) becomes the strongest shape on that stretch of floor and visibly joins the wall silhouette.

out_of_scope.request: Make the white body slightly less reflective (an off-white lacquer) so the sunlit front lands at 200-220 without lowering the room's exposure.
out_of_scope.why: The body colour #FFFFFF and its lacquer are fixed. It matters because the front faces both windows and the sun and takes about 1.6x the light of the unlit back wall (scene-linear 1.0 vs 0.61), so any exposure that models the white drops the walls about 0.6 EV; c4 lifts the walls instead.

out_of_scope.request: Lighten the accent lacquer so the gable and plinth still print as #C62828 after the exposure cut.
out_of_scope.why: The flavour colours are fixed. It matters because the red shares the white's light and matches today (gable [197,41,42], dE 0.5) only because the frame is about 0.6 EV hot; at the exposure the white needs it prints near [162,24,25], dE about 8, and no light in the card reaches the gable without also pooling on the floor around the plinth.
